This is my first set. No I don't have a Patreon or Fanbox, etc. I make this for the love of the game. I only make what I like and don't really take requests. Hopefully you like it too. I will be continuing this series and uploading it here, as well as making other series with characters I like. Some of my stuff will get pretty extreme, minus insects and guro I don't like that stuff. Before you ask, no i won't make a torrent. I don't know how. But if you care to explain in the comments I might try.

Also in the comments if you know how to get a more consistent style for images in NovelAi let me know, I think I'm using artists tags wrong or something.

If you like my stuff let me know! See you later.
